description.value: A government-operated BCLIQUOR retail store on Robson Street in Vancouver's West End, one of 198 provincial locations selling wine, spirits, beer, coolers, and ciders. The Robson Street location is situated in a high-traffic tourist and residential corridor. Knowledgeable product consultants are available in-store for beverage recommendations.
